rule: Publishing adapters may run only when verification=policy_verified AND runtime_enabled=true. This spike keeps every runtime_enabled=false.

providers.rate_or_quota: Default project quota: 100 videos.insert/day (own bucket, 1 unit/call), 100 search.list/day, 10000 units/day for other endpoints; resets midnight PT. Subject to change per Google docs.
providers.app_type_notes: Installed/mobile OAuth documented. Public apps using sensitive scopes require Google verification. No live publish exercised this spike.

providers.rate_or_quota: Meta documents Content Publishing rate expansion enabling up to 100 posts per day across feed, Stories, and Reels via API (2025-07-08 developer blog citing publishing docs). Confirm live limit in Content Publishing docs at enablement time.
providers.app_type_notes: Professional (Business/Creator) accounts. Meta docs require media hosted on a publicly accessible server at publish time (conflicts with offline-only local media unless a temporary upload path is added). Advanced Access may be required when publishing for accounts the app does not own.
blockers_to_enable: Meta app review / Advanced Access as required
Public media host or approved upload path

providers.official_api: Graph API Page photos/videos + Video API publishing
providers.rate_or_quota: Platform and Page rate limits apply per Meta Graph API; exact Page publish quotas not fixed as a single constant in the cited publishing guide. Measure under a real app token before enablement.
providers.app_type_notes: Page access token from a person with CREATE_CONTENT task. publish_video may be required for some video flows per Pages manage docs.

providers.rate_or_quota: Creator max_video_post_duration_sec returned by creator_info/query (example 300 in docs). Product/app-level posting quotas are governed by TikTok for Developers app configuration and audit; not a single public daily number in the Get Started page.
providers.app_type_notes: App must add Content Posting API, enable Direct Post, and obtain video.publish approval. Unaudited clients: posts restricted to private viewing until audit per Get Started note.
blockers_to_enable: TikTok developer app + scope approval + audit

providers.official_api: X API v2 POST /2/tweets + media upload
providers.rate_or_quota: OAuth 2.0 docs point to X rate-limits documentation; lookup limits differ by auth. Create-post media caps depend on posting user Premium status (default video attach 20 min / 8 GB). Commercial access tier required for uses beyond hobbyist/prototype per Developer Agreement Access Tiers language -- confirm current self-serve write entitlements with a developer account before enablement.
providers.app_type_notes: Official create-post and OAuth scopes documented. No Open Matchday X developer app created this spike; write access entitlement unverified against a live project.
blockers_to_enable: X developer account + access tier that includes POST /2/tweets for our app type

providers.rate_or_quota: Bluesky-hosted PDS repo ops: 5000 points/hour and 35000 points/day (CREATE=3, UPDATE=2, DELETE=1). Hosted PDS HTTP: 3000 requests / 5 minutes per IP (overall). Blob upload max 52428800 bytes (50 MiB) on hosted PDS.
providers.app_type_notes: Prefer atproto OAuth over legacy app passwords. Writing posts is a first-class documented API. No client credentials registered this spike.
Not evaluated for matchday social card/clip publishing this spike. Live ingest is a separate destination concern from AC-11 social publishing.
blockers_to_enable: Dedicated spike citing Helix/EventSub publish surfaces if product needs Twitch social posts
Cite LinkedIn Marketing/Share API docs if product prioritizes LinkedIn
